A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a model-based runtime verification framework that allows to check the correctness of the behavior of a system with respect to a set of properties expressed in RT-OCL at runtime.
we have developed a model-based runtime verification approach that can be used as service of a RTOS and that can be applied for the runtime verification of self-optimizing real-time systems.
we developed a model-based runtime verification approach for component-based real-time embedded systems which is able to verify properties expressed by RT-UML and RT-OCL.
The main takeaway from our work is that
model checking is not only a design-time activity.
the on-the-fly model-checking approach is applicable to on-line verification of component-based real-time system where the components can be dynamically exchanged.
the proposed approach allows for a very fast verification of the properties in the context of real-time systems.
